title: Motion bars chart
caption: The motion-bars-chart recipe: a title pill opens into a chart card, the bars grow on a stagger and the values count up to the exact approved wording. The numbers are illustrative.
prompt: Use the magnifito-promo skill to make a 5 second 16:9 clip for Magnifito, a Bulgarian digital marketing agency, in the motion-bars-chart style only: a chart titled "Leads per month (illustrative)" with three bars, before Magnifito 18, after three months 41, after six months 67. The numbers are illustrative: put them in claims.json and label the chart as illustrative. Use the motion engine. Brand colours are warm browns on cream (#7a584c, #ae8c72, #f0eadf), Geist for type, English on screen.
